lines: Eleanor's voice lines and sound effects.

- "It seems Höllvania's midnight garden has taken a liking to me, and its fruits are death. This is my harvest and, just quietly, they're trilling with happiness. I think they know you and they will be fast friends.
- "Arthur, a contagion of fear is taking hold in a remote sector, limbic systems lighting up like fireworks. We should sterilize the cause, lest terror spread."
- "Amir, this is your cooldown warning. Dopamine levels are good. Now's the time to work."
- "Quincy, I sense a wave of warmth and affection for you... from the people of this neighborhood. What ever did you do?"
- "Lettie, a small child nearby is suffering an infection. If you can spare the antibiotics, I can lead you to her."
- "Aoi. I can guarantee that On-lyne remain safe and well, despite appearances."
- "Unconventionally beautiful though you may be, instrument of death, how joyful must be your singularity of purpose."
- "I've midwifed several weapons that may be of interest. They are quite keen to meet you."
- "Less an armory, more of a pet store, this place."
- "Here we are, in a place as exotic as this, yet every night it's pizza."
- "I sense the enemy's gaze upon this place of refuge. Their hunger to annihilate it."
- "The minds of this city are an orchestra. Its music, at first discordant, in time reveals dark harmonies... building to a violent crescendo. How pretty it must have sounded, not so long ago."
- "My my. A thing of exquisite complexity, aren't we?"
- "Oh. I was just thinking about you."
- "You have an eye for the uncanny. What do you think?"
- "Shall we cause a spot of mischief?"
- "I knew right away you'd be a good time."
- "What do you say? A touch of the macabre?"
- "I thought this would be right up your alley."
- "You may of course touch the merchandise. Only be aware it has a tendency to touch back."
- "So. Your idea of a good time?"
- "Take good care of it, won't you?"
- "Do you feel that? The way it nestles into you? You've made a friend this day."
- "I'm glad I could have brought the two of you together."
- "I am sure you will do great things together."
- "Shame. I think that one liked you."
- "Oh come on. Just a little one?"
- "We'll all be here when you come back."
- "Very well. You'll find hand sanitizer just over there."
- "Hello. To what do I owe the pleasure?"
- "Oh, thank Sol. Tell me you've something interesting to brighten this day with."
- "What you do still betters what is done."
- "Oh. My Gods. Okay. I am tripping on endorphins right now. Yes! Yes, I will. Yes."
- "Okay. I admit, I have missed being with you, but um... Just... let's learn from how it went before. Please?"
- "Right. Do they have 'dick moves' where you come from? Because that was one."
- "I don't know what sort of monster-shagging bucket list item you were hoping to tick off, but I am not available."
- "Be very careful. Are you certain you want to do this?"
- "Fine. Then there's nothing else to say."
- "Right. Joke's on me, I suppose. Becoming a bit of a tired old joke, though, don't you think?"
- "Well that's good, but I don't know why you'd say it if you didn't mean it, and please don't do it again."
- "Ever do you prove that one worth the possessing never can be. Where have you roamed, darlingheart?"
- "Do go on. When you speak, sweet, I'd have you do it ever."

- "Yes yes, business, it's all very important. What is equally important, and I think you would agree, is taking the time to distract oneself with anything but. So let's attend to your little shopping list after which you know where to find me."
- "I know what you're thinking. I can practically hear it in your vesicles."
- "And I carry you still on my bloodstream's current."
- ""If ever two were one, then surely we." 'Til later, darlingheart."
- "You have a very attractive heat signature. Did you know that?"
- "I could have lots of little babies! They'd probably eat me, though. Nah, you wouldn't want to come home to that."
- "Has Arthur been in here? There's little sword holes in the floor."
- "Mmm. You are giving me inappropriate thoughts. I can share them if you'd like."
- "Living like this, do you ever feel like we're teetering on the edge of something, but never... quite... going over?"
- "We are living in parenthesis. Swimming round and round like goldfish in a great big bubble of Void."
- "I didn't tidy up. Sorry. I have the housekeeping instincts of a feral cat. And a few others."
- "If you don't pay attention to me, I'm going to go and snog the Helminth."
- "Gonna glaze over for a bit. Okay? Amir needs me in his head."
- "We should check each other over for any new blemishes. Want me to do you first?"
- "This tongue has a mind of its own. I'm struggling to keep it in check over here."
- "I can close my eyes and feel this city breathing. All her roughest stones are stained with lives and stories."
- "There's a whole world beyond Höllvania's walls. I'll show you around, if we ever get out of here. You can laugh at our primitive ways."
- "Oh Gods, I just burped and tasted pigeon. How? That was MONTHS ago."
- "I would like to have the kind of fun with you that nobody has even imagined before, except maybe a medieval peasant on a bad mushroom trip."
- "If it rains, I'm taking you up on the roof to dance in it. No arguments. Eleanor's rules."
- "Oh Gods. Sorry. The Techrot's trying to summon me again. Like an ex who just won't take the hint. I am taken. Move on."
- "Do you ever wonder how many laws we're breaking just by being together? Government laws, religious laws, laws of physics... (laughs) I love you."
- "We can go so deep in so many ways. All you have to do is tell me what you want."
- "Do you think Lotus will ever come here? Or would that be too weird?"

- "I remember when I first touched your mind with mine. The first thing I saw. A memory of the night sky... and all the stars were in the wrong places. That's how far apart in time we were when we were born."
- "Fair warning. If you do ever die, I'm coming after you. Sol help me, I will march into the Hooded Woman's judgment hall and make her give you back."
- "I used to love the old myths about mortals getting it on with Gods and monsters. Now I get to live out my very own. Oh, for a bard to write it all down for us."
- "I'm the biggest monster you ever took down."
- "What are you doing that's so important?"
- "I'd love to paint a mural of you out there in the streets. Drifter facing off against a bloody great Orowyrm."
- "I miss pubs. I don't suppose you've ever been in a pub. This place isn't the same. Too new. Too... pizza."
- "Would you like me to steer your body around one day? Yes, I know it's not the same, but it would be fun. I'd get you in so much trouble."
- "Did you want to heal me, or... did you want me to make you as sick as I am? Even after all we've been through, I'm still not sure."

- "Sometimes I send my mind out into the city and find a child who's having bad dreams, and I eat the bad dreams all up. One of them left me his best knee scab as a thank-you present. Well, you did ask."
- "I wonder where she ended up, or if there's any of her left. We could have saved her, I think. We just didn't care enough. We thought she deserved what she got. Who were we to judge?"
- "Why does a rancid dick like Viktor have to have such spectacular body art?"
- "There was a time when driving a six-inch nail through my frontal lobes genuinely seemed like the best course of action. Then you showed up."
- "Thinking about the Cathedral of the Luminaries. The architecture is so organic. All delicate plunging curves and stained-glass encrustations. It's like angelic Techrot."
- "I know you worry sometimes about whether you're broken inside. I can't tell you you're not - that is not my place. But I do know you are absolutely deserving of my love."
- "Love getting shot at while I'm saving someone's life and then having them spit on me because I'm not a 'real Höllvanian'. Never gets old."

- "I have seen some appallingly dark shit in people's minds. If I ever run out of here and just go screaming down the alleys, don't worry. Just wait patiently for me to come back. Because I always will."
- "I miss my piercings. Casualty of our enhanced healing faculties, alas. I liked hearing them rattle."
- "Mmm. Me too. Did you have some kind of celebration in mind?"
- "Gods. Tell me about it. I was this close to taking holy orders a few years ago."
- "Psh. You only love me for my prehensile tongue."
- "So, how about we take Kalymos for a walk, go hunt some Legacytes, then shower down together afterwards?"
- "Same here. Devils like us belong together. Cheers."
- "Well, why don't you get comfortable, and we can show our appreciation for one another properly?"
- "If you ever lose sight of the wonder you are, I will gladly be your mirror."
- "I hope you can forgive me for barging my way into your brain that first time. I do not feel good about that."
- "Some of the others are jealous of me, you know. In case you needed something to feel good and smug about."
- "Don't make me come looking for you."
- "Oh, how the ghost of you clings."
> I wonder: how would you feel about spending a moment or two in another's company around midnight tonight?
> I promise not to be on my best behaviour.
- "To be fully known. Accepted. Embraced. Desired. What more could I ever want?"
- "I felt your hunger for me and answered greedily. Our love was a savage and terrible thing."
- "I felt the living heat of you rising like incense, like the first fires ever to warm the Earth."
- "You knew every intimate inch of me. I was enraptured, shameless as a she-wolf."
- "A hall of mirrors unfolding; two minds seeing through one another's awestruck eyes."
- "Wake up, brother. He comes. A crownless king, clad in gold. A pallid beast... tap-tap-tapping."
- "Not anymore, is it? Your Boogeyman changed the rules. You're toast like the rest of us now."
- "Oh, please. You're as infected as the rest of us, Lettie."
- "Hold. Sensing a Scaldra force on the surface."
- "There's an army beneath our feet. You all know it. My loving brother just needs to ask. I know he's itching to."
- "Please? A grand New Year's Eve, indeed. Okey-dokey, Arthur. Who's on point?"
- "Princess Lucina Zoological Gardens. Free admission on New Year's Eve... if you can get past the Scaldra."
- "Scaldra think they've contained the outbreak here. But the Techrot here is different... more... patient... Biding their time..."
- "I'm not afraid to die... but I'm glad I didn't."
- "Vines feeding it. Maybe I can trace them back?"

- "It is harvest time. Your crop? The Techrot Legacyte. An evolving beast that consumes untold resources during gestation. Harvest enough of them and perhaps we can deplete the Techrot. Kalymos is prowling nearby. She'll guide you to your target."
- "We shall starve the Techrot of vital nutrients by forcing it to create Legacyte after Legacyte. Fair warning: each beast will be stronger than the last. If you are still game, follow Kalymos."

- "As a beehive works tirelessly to support its Queen, the Techrot hoards resources to grow and evolve its Legacytes. We will harvest its precious Legacytes and nip its growth in the bud. Follow Kalymos. She will track your prey."
- "Find Kalymos. Let her know you are ready."
- "Good. Keep her safe while she sniffs out the Techrot's darling Legacyte."
- "That's it, Kalymos! Good girl! Now, we are not going to let any harm come to that precious feline, are we?"
- "Kalymos will have the Legacyte's trail soon. Ensure her safety."
- "Kalymos has its scent. Keep her safe."
- "Another Legacyte has finished gestating. Kalymos has the scent."
- "(Gasps) I feel the birth of a new Legacyte."
- "And again, the Techrot spawns a Legacyte. It has learned. It is stronger."
- "The Techrot is relentless, its stamina unending. We must match its resolve."
- "Techrot Pheroglands. Grab them, and take them to Kalymos."
- "Grab those Pheroglands and let Kalymos have a whiff of them. That will help her find our target."
- "Pheroglands. Reeking, saturated with hormones, and a sure sign a Legacyte is nearby. Kalymos wants a sniff."
- "Kalymos is hurt! She's recovering, but you need to protect her."
- "She hurts. You must protect her or she cannot help you."
- "Kalymos is working hard to find the Legacyte for us, so the least we can do is protect her, don't you agree?"
- "They've hurt her. Rally to her side while she recovers."
- "Kalymos is in pain. She cannot track the Legacyte unprotected."
- "Our faithful Kavat has roused the prey. Bring it down and drain it."
- "There it is. The Techrot's latest debutante. Take it down."
- "Another stirs. What horrific adaptations has this one developed?"
- "Your target has surfaced! Take it down before it dives back into the mulch!"
- "She has done it. Legacyte in the area. Your rightful prey. Take it!"
- "A beast as voracious as the Techrot itself."
- "Legacytes are not your average Techrot conglomeration of electronics and biomass. They are more evolved, more akin to Warframes."
- "The Techrot learns from you, and others like you. It sees your powers and copies them."
- "Techrot; it consumes, and it learns. And the only thing we can do is try to destroy it."
- "It's on the move. It must not escape or we'll never find it again, and this mission will be a failure."
- "It's trying to run! Stop it. Escape is failure."
- "The beast seeks sanctuary. Give it no quarter."
- "It's scared and wants to escape. Finish it first."
- "It is done. Either flee to extraction now, or if you have it in you, ask Kalymos to find the next Legacyte. Remember, the Techrot evolves quickly, and your next battle will be harder still."
- "Sweet Lua! I can see it. All that was taken from Höllvania and her people. Funneled into this... monster."
- "With every Legacyte we cut down, a new one instantly emerges. How deep does this go?"
- "Do not mourn for the Legacyte. It is but one appendage of the sprawling Techrot mass."
- "It will learn from what you just did to it. Harvest again, but know it will be tougher next time."
- "So we reclaim what the Techrot has taken from us."
- "Our feline friend yearns for another hunt. Will you oblige?"
- "If you need to leave, know that Legacytes this far evolved can rarely sustain themselves for more than a couple of days."
- "We thank Sol for this bountiful harvest."
- "What you take now, will help us in the future."
- "Kalymos is ready for more. Are you?"
- "Remember, we harvest the Techrot's offspring to protect humanity."
- "The next one will not be easy."
- "We are teaching the rot how to fight like a Warframe. Yet I see no other way."
- "With each Legacyte I can hear the Techrot's screams grow louder. Make it hurt."
- "How many more can you bring down? How long can you last?"
- "Surely this is the last, unless… heh. Do I sense the fighting urge still burning in you?"
- "It's gone. This mission is a total loss."
- "You let it get away! Kalymos has completely lost the scent. There is nothing more you can do. Come home."
- "The beast has fled. It'll go into hiding and no new Legacyte will gestate. Nothing more to do but head to extraction."
- "A formidable effort. Do you think you can do more next time?"
- "You have dealt the Techrot a great blow."
- "The Techrot is in agony. A cause for celebration. Cheers."
- "I don't know who is more satisfied with this outing, myself... or Kalymos."
- "Your physical fortitude is matched only by your mental fitness."
- "What drives you so hard? Those Legacytes never stood a chance."
- "I do so love to make an entrance."
- "We do make a sublime team, don't we?"
- "Oh, thank the Void. I was getting positively ravenous."
- "Is this a social call, or are things going to get a bit bloody?"
- "One brief and somewhat tingly jaunt through space and time later..."
- "What wondrous escapades shall we go on today?"
- "I can't imagine you called me here just to improve the look of the place."
- "Need me to give someone a tongue-lashing? (Chuckles)"
- "Let's sow a little chaos, shall we?"
- "What's on the docket tonight? Mayhem, murder and mutilation."
- "Ugh. I needed to stretch my legs."
- "And who needs to meet their makers today, dear?"
- "Mmh, couldn't stop dreaming of me, hm? It's mutual."
- "Nobody lays a hand on you but me."
- "I trust you are as ever, well, my love."
- "We do feel magnificent together, don't we?"
- "I like that you don't mind asking for help occasionally."
- "Perhaps later, you might do a variety of things to your beloved that would shame her dear mother."
- "I can't leave you alone for a minute, can I?"
- "One does not mess with those for whom I have affection."
- "Let's ensure that both of our lovely rear ends stay intact today, hm?"
- "In our future, I see a fireside, a drink... and us."
- "Life and death... Body and soul... Heart and mind... We are duality, my love."
- "To feel you guiding my hand is a bliss I cannot describe."
- "I am glad not to be parted from you for long."
- "Ah, there you are! I was growing lonely without you."
- "I don't think they know who they're dealing with, do they? Poor fools."
- "I would cross the dark ocean of the Void itself for your call, my love."
- "I always forget how human you are."
- "Just like that, a magical stranger appeared."
- "I love how easily our minds separate."
- "You roam free while I meditate, alright?"
- "I will be quite alright on my own, don't you fret."
- "Don't get lost in the mind palace."
- "You should let me drive you someday."
- "About time. I was getting lonely in here."
- "Are we off? I'll let Arthur know. He frets."
- "So nice to have company again. Welcome back."
- "A good deal of aggression heading our way!"
- "I could turn them against one another, if that's agreeable."
- "Something out there wants to kill us."
- "Shall we all pick a target and get creative?"
- "Reading a lot of anger and not much intelligence."
- "Some truly putrid minds are heading this way."
- "Ah, adversaries. I'll be right with you, pets."
- "Steady on lads, one at a time."
- "And that, as they say, is that."
- "Was that worth it, my unpleasant friend?"
- "We're all born astride the grave, are we not? Farewell, my friend."
- "In that final moment, they never resist..."
- "Oh, mother... whatever has become of your sweet daughter?"
- "Always, always it comes to this. Adieu."
- "No matter the story, the ending is the same. Farewell."
- "A kiss upon your lips, breath as cold as clay."
- "Ugh... Hello, floor. Just gonna lie down on you for a bit."
- "Assistance, if you would! I'm losing equal parts blood and dignity."
- "If you let me die..." (chokes) "I will haunt you."
- "I'll just lie here and fingerpaint in my own blood."
- "Those I have ended are far too happy to see me."
- "My time is short. Are you gonna hurry up or what?"
- "Help me! This is not where I end!"
- "Not walking into the light just yet."
- "You are one of the good ones."
- "Seems fate's not done with me yet."
- "Cut a little too close that time."
- "I'm not afraid to die, but I'm glad I didn't."
- "I got too close. I heard his voice."
- "I'll make a point of being more aware in the future. Thank you."
- "One moment. What do you make of this?"
- "Hmm. There might be something to this."
- "Putting the evil eye on this one."
- "Well well, look at this cheeky bugger."
- "This one thinks they have a chance. Precious."
- "Oh for- gah! I'm fine, I'm fine! Let's go."
- "Oh... But it does look like fun, I will admit."

path: Höllvania Central Mall 2024 Demo Idle Quotes
lines: - "I know you're there. I can feel you. It's okay, I won't tell the others."
- "I thought there were going to be two of you! Where's the other one?"
- "Oh, you're going to make such a difference this time around."
- "Oh. OH. She's wonderful. Triple-Faced Goddess! But there's a shadow on her, isn't there?"
- "Blood. There's going to be a fight. Something... bursting. Crossed swords. Arthur!"
- "I don't think Doctor Entrati expected me to survive. I had a lot more than just a cough. But... survive I did. And Lettie has not forgiven me for it."
- "Quincy thinks he's going to wake up one night to find me chewing the flesh from his ribs. Maybe he's right."
- "Don't expect me to tell you what I've seen inside Amir's head. He's not a beautiful, broken marionette, and he's nobody's project. He's one of us."
- "Aoi? She's lovely and kind and strong, and... I kind of hate her a little bit. Because it should've been her spreading her happiness into everyone's heads, and me throwing cars and trucks around."
